# SensibleJS

> Reactive UI in ~5KB gzipped. No build step. No virtual DOM. No dependencies. Just HTML attributes.

## Quickstart

```html
<script src="sensibljs.min.js" defer></script>

<input s-bind="name" placeholder="Your name">
<p s-bind="name">Hello, {name}!</p>

<script>
let store = {
    persist: true,
    data: {
        name: { type: String, default: '' }
    }
};
</script>
```

No initialization call needed. SensibleJS detects `window.store` and starts automatically.

## Store Schema

```js
let store = {
    persist: true,          // Save to localStorage (default: true)
    localPrefix: '__',      // Prefix for localStorage keys (default: '__')
    data: { /* variables */ },
    onInit: function(data) { /* runs after init */ }
};
```

### Variable Options

```js
data: {
    name:    { type: String,  default: '' },
    count:   { type: Number,  default: 0 },
    active:  { type: Boolean, default: true },
    items:   { type: Array,   default: [] },
    config:  { type: Object,  default: { theme: 'dark' } },
    total:   { computed: 'price * qty' },               // read-only
    search:  { type: String, default: '', persist: false, watch: function(n, o) {} }
}
```

| Option     | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `type`     | `String`, `Number`, `Boolean`, `Array`, `Object` |
| `default`  | Initial value |
| `persist`  | Per-variable override of store.persist |
| `computed` | Expression string; read-only getter |
| `watch`    | `function(newVal, oldVal)` called on change |

## Directives

| Directive       | Purpose |
|-----------------|---------|
| `s-bind`        | Two-way binding for inputs + display |
| `s-if`          | Conditional show/hide |
| `s-for`         | List rendering from arrays |
| `s-text`        | Set textContent (safe) |
| `s-html`        | Set innerHTML (trusted content only) |
| `s-class`       | Toggle CSS classes conditionally |
| `s-css`         | Dynamic inline styles |
| `s-attr`        | Dynamic HTML attributes |
| `s-click`       | Click handler |
| `s-unclick`     | Click-outside handler |
| `s-on`          | General event binding with modifiers |
| `s-ref`         | Name element, access via `$refs` |
| `s-cloak`       | Hide until initialized |
| `s-data`        | Inline variable definition (no store) |
| `s-debounce`    | Delay input updates (ms) |
| `s-blur`        | Update on blur instead of keyup |
| `s-transition`  | CSS enter/leave animation |
| `s-src`         | Dynamic image src (for use in s-for) |
| `s-key`         | Unique key for s-for reconciliation |

## s-bind

```html
<input type="text" s-bind="name">
<input type="text" s-bind="name" s-blur>
<input type="checkbox" s-bind="active">
<input type="radio" s-bind="color" value="red" name="color">
<select s-bind="option"><option value="a">A</option></select>
<input type="number" s-bind="qty">
<input type="range" s-bind="volume" min="0" max="100">
<input type="color" s-bind="accent">
<input type="date" s-bind="startDate">
<img s-bind="avatarUrl">
<p s-bind="name">Hello, {name}!</p>
<div contenteditable="true" s-bind="notes"></div>
```

## s-if

```html
<div s-if="isLoggedIn">Welcome back!</div>
<div s-if="items.length === 0">No items yet.</div>
<div s-if="show" s-transition="fade">Animated</div>
```

Preserves original `display` value (flex, grid, inline, etc.).

## s-for

```html
<div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id">
    {item.name} - ${item.price}
</div>
```

### Directives inside s-for

All directives work inside s-for templates with access to the loop variable:

```html
<div s-for="t of tasks" s-key="t.id">
    <span s-text="t.title"></span>
    <span s-class="done: t.done; urgent: t.priority === 'high'"></span>
    <span s-if="t.done">Completed</span>
    <span s-attr="data-priority: t.priority; disabled: t.done"></span>
    <span s-css="color: {t.done ? 'gray' : 'black'}"></span>
    <span s-html="t.richDescription"></span>
    <button s-click="tasks.updateWhere('id', t.id, {done: !t.done})">Toggle</button>
    <button s-click="tasks.removeWhere('id', t.id)">Remove</button>
    <img s-src="{t.imageUrl}">
</div>
```

Single quotes work in directive attribute values inside s-for (e.g., `s-if="t.due !== ''"`).

Available in loop scope: the loop variable (`t` above) and `index` (0-based).

### s-if wrapper around s-for (empty state pattern)

Wrap `s-for` in an `s-if` to show/hide the list with an alternate empty state:

```html
<div s-if="items.length > 0">
    <div s-for="item of items" s-key="item.id">
        <span s-text="item.name"></span>
    </div>
</div>
<div s-if="items.length === 0">No items yet.</div>
```

This is the recommended pattern for conditional list rendering with empty states.

### Reactivity in arrays

Observed methods: `push`, `pop`, `splice`, `reverse`, `shift`, `sort`, `unshift`, `concat`, `update`, `updateWhere`, `removeWhere`.

```js
// WRONG: direct index assignment is NOT reactive
items[0].done = true;

// RIGHT: update by index
items.update(i, { done: true });

// RIGHT: update by property match
items.updateWhere('id', 123, { done: true });

// RIGHT: remove by property match
items.removeWhere('id', 123);

// RIGHT: splice still works for full control
items.splice(i, 1, Object.assign({}, items[i], { done: true }));
```

### Event handling inside s-for

`s-click` and `s-on` work inside s-for with access to the loop variable and `index`. Store variables remain reactive (mutations trigger re-renders).

```html
<div s-for="t of tasks" s-key="t.id">
    <input type="checkbox" s-attr="checked: t.done"
           s-click="tasks.updateWhere('id', t.id, {done: !t.done})">
    <button s-click="tasks.removeWhere('id', t.id)">x</button>
</div>
```

For handlers outside s-for scope (e.g. `onclick` on elements not in a loop), use `$find(array, el)`:

```html
<button onclick="toggle(this)">Toggle</button>
<script>
function toggle(el) {
    var match = $find(tasks, el);  // returns {item, index} or null
    if (match) tasks.update(match.index, { done: !match.item.done });
}
</script>
```

## s-text / s-html

```html
<p s-text="username"></p>
<span s-text="'Hello, ' + name"></span>
<div s-html="richContent"></div>
```

## s-class

Semicolon-separated `class: expression` pairs:

```html
<div s-class="active: isActive; error: hasError; hidden: !isVisible"></div>
```

## s-css

```html
<div s-css="background-color: {accentColor}; width: {percent + '%'}"></div>
```

## s-attr

```html
<button s-attr="disabled: !formValid">Submit</button>
<a s-attr="href: linkUrl; target: openInNew ? '_blank' : '_self'">Link</a>
```

`false`/`null`/`undefined` removes the attribute. `true` sets empty attribute.

## s-on

Format: `event.modifier: expression`. Modifiers: `.prevent`, `.stop`, `.enter`, `.escape`.

```html
<input s-on="keydown.enter: submit()">
<form s-on="submit.prevent: handleSubmit()">
<div s-on="mouseenter: hover = true; mouseleave: hover = false">
```

## s-click / s-unclick

```html
<button s-click="count++">+1</button>
<div s-unclick="menuOpen = false">Dropdown</div>
```

## s-ref

```html
<input s-ref="myInput">
<button s-click="$refs.myInput.focus()">Focus</button>
```

## s-data (inline state)

```html
<div s-data="{count: 0}">
    <button s-click="count++">+</button>
    <span s-bind="count">{count}</span>
</div>
```

## s-debounce / s-blur

```html
<input s-bind="search" s-debounce="300">
<input s-bind="bio" s-blur>
```

## s-transition

```html
<div s-if="show" s-transition="fade">Content</div>
```

CSS classes applied: `fade-enter`, `fade-enter-active`, `fade-enter-to`, `fade-leave`, `fade-leave-active`, `fade-leave-to`.

## Computed values

```js
data: {
    price: { type: Number, default: 10 },
    qty:   { type: Number, default: 1 },
    total: { computed: 'price * qty' }
}
```

Read-only. Recalculates when dependencies change. Supports transitive dependencies.

### Computed array patterns

Computed values can derive filtered, sorted, or aggregated views from arrays:

```js
data: {
    txs:    { type: Array, default: [] },
    filter: { type: String, default: 'all', persist: false },
    query:  { type: String, default: '', persist: false },

    // Filtered + searched view (iterate over this in s-for, not the raw array)
    visibleTxs: {
        computed: "txs.filter(function(t) { " +
            "var matchType = filter === 'all' || t.type === filter; " +
            "var matchQuery = query.length === 0 || t.desc.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase()) !== -1; " +
            "return matchType && matchQuery; " +
            "}).slice().reverse()"
    },

    // Aggregations
    totalExpenses: { computed: "txs.reduce(function(s,t){ return t.type==='expense' ? s+t.amount : s; }, 0)" },
    totalIncome:   { computed: "txs.reduce(function(s,t){ return t.type==='income' ? s+t.amount : s; }, 0)" },
    netBalance:    { computed: "totalIncome - totalExpenses" }
}
```

Use `function(){}` syntax (not arrow functions) in computed expressions for broadest compatibility.

## Persistence

```js
let store = {
    persist: true,
    localPrefix: 'myapp_',
    data: {
        saved:     { type: String, default: '' },              // persisted
        temporary: { type: String, default: '', persist: false } // not persisted
    }
};
```

`store.persist` and per-variable `persist` can be toggled at runtime.

### Runtime persistence toggle pattern

To let users toggle localStorage on/off, store the toggle state in its own localStorage key
(outside the store's prefix) since the toggle itself can't use the store's persistence:

```js
data: {
    persist: { type: Boolean, default: localStorage.getItem('myapp_persist') !== '0', persist: false }
}
```

```js
function togglePersist(cb) {
    persist = cb.checked;
    localStorage.setItem('myapp_persist', persist ? '1' : '0');
    store.persist = persist;
    // For per-variable toggles:
    ['items', 'settings'].forEach(function(f) { store.data[f].persist = persist; });
    if (!persist) {
        // Clear stored data
        var prefix = store.localPrefix;
        ['items', 'settings'].forEach(function(f) { localStorage.removeItem(prefix + f); });
    }
}
```

```js
onInit: function(data) {
    store.persist = persist;  // Sync store.persist with the restored toggle value
}
```

## Expression sandbox

Expressions use `new Function()` in a sandboxed scope.

**Blocked:** `document`, `window`, `self`, `globalThis`, `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `Function`, `importScripts`, `setTimeout`, `setInterval`, `Proxy`, `Reflect`, `eval`, `constructor`, `__proto__`, `prototype`.

**Allowed:** `Math`, `parseInt`, `parseFloat`, `JSON`, `console`, `isNaN`, `isFinite`, `String`, `Number`, `Boolean`, `Array`, `Object`, `Date`, `RegExp`, `Map`, `Set`, `atob`, `btoa`, `encodeURI`, `decodeURI`.

## Variables are window globals

All store variables are accessible as plain globals: `name`, `count`, `items`, etc. No `.value` wrapper.

```js
// Setting a variable triggers reactivity
count = 5;
items.push({ id: 1, text: 'New' });
```
